question: In the morning, the cash tin at Ravi's tea stall held 121 rupees, more than the 100 rupees in Meena's tin at the stall beside his. During the morning Ravi added 35 rupees from early customers. In the afternoon he put in 59 rupees from lunch orders and then 36 rupees from a group of tourists. In the evening his uncle matched everything in the tin rupee for rupee, doubling it. How many rupees are in Ravi's tin now?

An art school ordered 162 crayon kits at 4 dollars each. It handed 98 kits to the junior class and 16 kits to the senior class. Each of the kits still in the cupboard contains 3 pouches, and each pouch holds 9 crayons. The cupboard also holds 77 loose crayons in a tin and 15 loose crayons in a drawer. How many crayons are in the cupboard?

Lars's printing press prints 90 pages every minute, faster than Mia's press, which prints 60 pages a minute. Lars runs the press for 8 minutes on each job, completes 6 jobs in every hour, works 6 hours a day, and finishes a contract in 4 days. He divides the whole stack of pages equally between 2 clients, and the Oak Publishing share is then divided equally among its 5 branches. How many pages does Oak Publishing's Harbour branch receive?

In the morning, Leo's ferry left the harbour with 189 passengers, more than the 150 on Ana's ferry. At the first island 186 passengers got off, and 1 more got off at the lighthouse jetty. In the afternoon 32 passengers boarded for the return trip. Every passenger on the return trip paid 6 tokens, and Leo spent 76 tokens on fuel. In the evening he exchanged his remaining tokens at the harbour office, which pays 3 dollars for each token. How many dollars did Leo receive?

In the morning, Ken picked 196 strawberries, more than the 150 that Yuki picked in the same field, which covers 2 hectares. Before lunch he picked 67 more. In the afternoon he added another 10 strawberries and then divided all his strawberries equally among 3 baskets, taking only 1 basket home. In the evening he ate 87 strawberries from his basket. How many strawberries are left in Ken's basket?

In the morning, Ivy had 15 dollars in her purse, and her aunt gave her 7 dollars. She spent 9 dollars on a book before lunch. In the afternoon she spent 12 dollars on a cinema ticket. In the evening her brother offered to match whatever was in her purse and gave her exactly that, doubling it. Then her grandmother gave her 59 dollars. How many dollars does Ivy have now?

A charity store received 152 donated blankets, and it opens twice a week. It gave 130 blankets to a shelter, 20 to a hospital, and 1 to a passer-by. A hotel then donated 42 blankets. The store paid a laundry 7 dollars to clean each blanket it now had. How many dollars did the store pay the laundry?

In the morning, the warehouse at a fruit market held 236 crates of apples, and by noon a delivery had tripled the number of crates. In the afternoon 8 more crates arrived from a small orchard, followed by 59 crates from a larger one. In the evening a final lorry brought another 59 crates. How many crates of apples are in the warehouse now?

In the morning, a tanker delivered 7 barrels of cider to the harvest festival, each barrel holding 217 litres, and half of the barrels were oak. Before lunch a farmer added 43 litres from his own press. In the afternoon 551 litres were served to visitors. In the evening 247 litres more were served. The organisers log the cider in litres even though the supplier bills in kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres of cider are left?

A biology student counts 56 bacterial colonies on a dish and adds 27 more colonies from a second dish. The incubator is kept at 37 degrees. Overnight, each colony on the dish grows into 9 colonies. The next day 545 colonies die after a dose of antibiotic. Over the following night each surviving colony splits into 6 colonies. How many colonies are on the dish now?

A tailor had 211 metres of ribbon in her workshop, and a dozen apprentices worked there. She used 129 metres for wedding dresses and 69 metres for hats. She cut each remaining metre of ribbon into 7 equal strips. Of these strips, 41 were spoiled by a stain. From each good strip she made 9 small bows, and she already had 17 bows in a box. How many bows does the tailor have?

In the morning, the Red Fox team scored 63 points at each of the 9 stations of a scavenger hunt. Before lunch the judges took away 125 points for a rule breach. In the afternoon the team earned 67 points on a bonus puzzle. In the evening's final challenge, the team's score was multiplied by 8, and then the team received 75 points for finishing first. How many points did the Red Fox team finish with?

Tom logs his violin practice in minutes. His daily routine is 29 minutes of scales, and this week he adds 14 minutes of sight-reading to every daily session. He practises this routine on each of 6 days. He also does an extra 17 minutes before his lesson and 49 minutes at an orchestra rehearsal. His teacher asks for the total in hours, and Tom knows that sixty minutes make one hour, but he writes his total in minutes. How many minutes does Tom log this week?

In the morning, Mira started a fundraising jar, and each of her 5 friends put 66 dollars into it. She then divided the jar's money equally into 2 jars and kept only 1 of them, giving the other to the school. The jar is 30 centimetres tall. In the afternoon her neighbour added 35 dollars to Mira's jar, and Mira took out 20 dollars to buy poster paint. In the evening a local business promised to make the jar's contents 4 times as large, and it did. How many dollars are in Mira's jar now?

Kara collected 196 shells on the first day of her beach holiday, more than the 150 that her brother Finn collected. The beach is 3 kilometres long. On the second day she found 22 more shells, and on the third day 28. On the fourth day she found 75 shells, on the fifth day 58, and on the last day just 7. How many shells did Kara collect in total?

A community hall, which is 40 metres long, had 212 folding chairs, and 36 more were donated. The caretaker divided all the chairs equally among 4 rooms. In the blue room, 35 chairs were later found to be broken and were thrown away. The hall then rented out every chair left in the blue room for 6 dollars each for a wedding. The caretaker counts the coins in cents and records the total in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars did the hall earn from renting the blue room's chairs?

An online petition to keep the village library open had 163 signatures, and the library currently opens twice a week. Over the weekend 69 more people signed. The organisers then removed 84 signatures that were duplicates. The petition itself is 3 pages long. After a well-known author shared it, the number of signatures grew to 8 times what it had been. A final check then struck out 818 signatures as invalid. How many signatures does the petition have now?

Ivo and Lea are playing a trading board game. Ivo has 204 coins, more than the 150 coins Lea has. Ivo pays 83 coins in rent and then 73 coins in tax. He lands on a bonus square that multiplies his coins by 5. He then draws a card that makes him divide his coins equally into 2 piles and give 1 pile to the bank. Finally he collects 17 coins for passing the start square. How many coins does Ivo have now?

A printer is preparing a report for a dozen committee members. The main text runs to 226 pages, the appendix adds 25 pages, and the index adds another 43 pages to each copy. She prints 8 complete copies of the report. She also prints 62 cover sheets to wrap the copies. She weighs the paper in grams and records the parcel weight in kilograms, since a thousand grams make one kilogram. How many pages does the printer produce in total?

Tess keeps a jar of buttons, and she sews twice a week. The jar held 99 buttons, and she added 56 buttons from an old coat. She used 102 buttons on a quilt and then found 11 buttons in her sewing box, which has 5 drawers, and dropped them into the jar. She then divided all the buttons in the jar equally into 4 tins and kept only 1 tin for herself. How many buttons are in the tin Tess kept?

In the morning, each of the 7 cashiers at a market started with 220 cents in coins in their float, and all the floats were counted as one pool. During the afternoon 1013 cents from the pool were handed out as change. In the evening a customer paid 63 cents in coins into the pool, and the manager added 19 cents she found on the floor. The market has 4 entrances. The manager writes the pool total in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents are in the coin pool now?

In the morning, a bakery had 22 empty trays, and it sent 18 of them to a cafe. The oven was set to 200 degrees. In the afternoon each remaining tray was filled with 9 rolls, and all the rolls were then shared equally among 3 hampers. In the evening 1 roll was taken out of the first hamper and eaten. The bakery prices rolls in cents but writes its bills in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many rolls are in the first hamper now?

Hana collected 132 empty cans for recycling, more than the 100 cans her friend Jun collected. She collected 70 more at the park and 6 at the bus stop. She divided all her cans equally among 4 sacks and kept 1 sack, giving the others to Jun. She then found 3 more cans in her garden and 15 in her garage and put them in her sack. The recycling centre pays in cents, and Hana converts to dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cans are in Hana's sack?

In the morning, a bottling line filled 172 bottles of juice, and then a second run of exactly the same size doubled the total. In the afternoon 73 bottles came over from a second line and 71 from a third. In the evening the bottles were sold to a cafe, and each bottle fills 7 glasses, with each glass priced at 3 dollars. How many dollars will the cafe take if it sells every glass?

Ida had 93 cents in her pocket, more than the 80 cents her friend Bo had. She spent 49 cents on an apple. Her mother gave her 53 cents. She then spent 64 cents on a pencil and 10 cents on a sweet. Ida keeps her diary in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents does Ida have now?
